patterns: PYQs are dominated by Census figures: 31.16% urban (2011), 53 million-plus cities, 3,894 census towns, Goa most / HP least urbanised, Sikkim fastest urban growth.
Census-town criteria (5,000 - 75% male non-farm - 400/sq km) and the moderate phase 1931-61 recur, often with near-miss distractors (60%, 31.80%).
APPSC frames it as 'highest / second highest growth in urban population' state items.
App adds finance, governance and UN-Habitat items with fewer pure Census number questions; mostly sound but includes off-topic Satavahana items.
